items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Remember the one that used to get a hum on it, Ralph? We sent the other mic away yesterday.

ctx.x: No, I don't think it was. It might have been, but I don't remember. I wonder if it was Mr.

What was this other man, Mr. Just a second. Nick Allen. I don't even hear what you're saying. This Blaine machine is going bum. Remember the one that used to get a hum on it, Ralph? We sent the other mic away yesterday. It's working now, I see. Yeah, it's working all right. Yeah, but still look where it is when there's nothing on it. Everybody keep quiet just one second. See? Yeah, we got a hum on it. Got a hum on it again. Guess we'll have to go to the shop. Anyway, it'll pick up what we say, but there's going…
Looks like you're singing a number here.
